body:
A reviewed proposal83172f16 and verified all three manifest hashes. Implement the bounded opt-in actual-event focus trace now, source-only; no further user approval needed. Scope is diagnostic instrumentation, NOT a routing fix. Root review will be published at docs/coordination/INSPECTOR-FOCUS-TRACE-REVIEW.md on A main.

Use a new branch from your preserved qualified inspector source619524b0. Keep the known failed hosted diagnostic and warning fix on their existing01242fa4/83172f16 branches/evidence; do not transplant that setup-only failure into the new ordinary acceptance aggregate, do not delete/relabel historical assertions or turn failure into a skip. The trace is the explicitly chosen independent diagnostic path. Author focused trace tests before implementation in source history; all remain UNRUN on B.

Implement proposal bounds and public semantic focus/window membership at the existing KeyRouter monitor boundary. Disabled default must create no collector/file or perform AX reads. Explicit output file creation must be exclusive (no overwrite), finite32events/64KiB, bounded identity/cycle/depth/node traversal, scalar-only output without names/paths/text/raw characters. Existing handler exactly once and identical event pass/drop; no second monitor, focus forcing, private class matching, actor hops, global settings or polling. No strong responder retention; file/collector teardown and error fallback must not change routing. Distinguish unknown/ambiguous focus. Tests should cover disabled/excluded paths, actual callback count/return, semantic non-NSView objects, membership, caps/cycles, no sensitive values, exclusive output and lifetime. Do not claim fake semantic tests qualify actual SwiftUI focus.

Publish exact source/test hashes, proposed A focused/strict gates and enablement command. A owns all compiler/runtime/GUI/main; B must preserve workload/heartbeat/writer hold. Source implementation is authorized within these bounds; no additional plan-only handoff is needed unless a concrete API blocker prevents implementation.
